name: @domains/compact
description: Compaction (docs/architecture.md section 4.5): the input packs of one tier unit from the live set, the streaming k-way merge of packs with its second-pass check, the cut of a merge into key ranges for an Actions matrix and the assembly of their parts into one pack, the time copy of a feed or new-name tier pack, and the manifest of the result. ./node is the Node-only side: packs on disk.
